overlap.method: Video groups inferred only from explicit MOV/mp4 filename roots; same-video frame overlap is a risk indicator, not proof of identical pixels. SHA256 checks exact file duplication. Test split not used.

method.matching: Predictions in descending confidence; match at most one unused GT of same class by highest IoU. Fixed operating-point precision/recall, NOT AP/mAP.
method.sampling: All validation images, no selection by score.
